sql: WITH recent AS (SELECT customer_id FROM (SELECT * FROM shop.main.orders WHERE tenant_id = $1) orders) SELECT r.*, c.id, c.name, NULL AS email, c.tenant_id, c.created_at, generate_series.*, sluice_sub1.* FROM recent r JOIN (SELECT * FROM shop.main.customers WHERE tenant_id = $2) c ON c.id = r.customer_id, generate_series(1, 2), (SELECT 1 AS one) sluice_sub1
